visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-fidelity CGI animation sequence featuring a female character with long, dual-colored hair—half deep purple and half golden blonde. She lies in a celestial, cosmic environment with glowing starlight and soft, diffused light. Close-ups emphasize her intricate blue dress, facial features, and the ethereal particles floating around her. (2) The scene shifts to a mobile gaming interface showing a character selection menu. A grid of character cards with various hero portraits and skin titles is displayed. The UI is dense with colorful icons, currency symbols, and text labels indicating different skin tiers and hero names against a dark, stylized background. (3) Gameplay footage begins on a traditional MOBA map with green grass, stone paths, and architectural structures. A character model moves across the terrain, performing basic attacks and circular movement skills. Small health bars and damage indicators appear above the character and opponents. The camera uses a standard isometric perspective typical of mobile games. (4) The focus intensifies on the character's special abilities. Activating her ultimate creates a massive circular field on the ground. This field alternates between a cool blue moon aesthetic and a radiant golden sun aesthetic, featuring complex geometric star patterns and falling floral petals. Bright particle effects and light rays dominate the screen during these skill triggers. (5) The final visual phase displays a screen capture of a mobile Instagram profile for 'SCG AOV NEWS'. The white interface shows the account handle, follower count, and a grid of recent video thumbnails. A red circle highlights the follow button before the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator with an excited, high-arousal voice starts speaking over an upbeat, synthesizer-driven electronic background track. His speech rate is fast and enthusiastic as he introduces the new game skin. The BGM has a clear, rhythmic 4/4 beat with light percussive elements. (2) Digital UI clicks and metallic chime SFX trigger as the narration mentions the 'waiting screen.' The narrator's pitch variability increases as he expresses shock. The BGM remains steady in the background, providing a vibrant, energetic floor for the commentary. (3) During the gameplay demonstration, sharp magical whoosh SFX and bass-heavy impact sounds are heard, synchronized with the character's skill visuals. These sound effects have high spectral brightness. The narrator uses high-pitched exclamations like 'Wow!' and 'Crap!', increasing his vocal intensity and loudness. (4) The audio transitions to a closing segment where the narrator's tone remains friendly but more informative. He provides a call to action for viewers to check the YouTube link. The BGM continues until the end, where it is briefly layered with a final social media click sound before cutting to studio silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase and commentary for a new 'twin' skin for the character Lauriel in the game Arena of Valor (傳說對決). It aims to generate hype among the gaming community by highlighting the high-quality animation and unique dual-form skill effects while providing news-style commentary.
